The build

From the first line to opening night.

Scroll, and the café builds itself: the plan, the sketch, the shell, the joinery, the finishes, the lights. A café at eight in the morning. One team from the first drawing to the first service.

The build: a café shown in seven stages, from the first drawing to opening morning, with a short note from the studio at each stage. At the end you can take the corner table to see our services. You can skip the build at any time.

Motion is reduced on your device, so the build is shown as three stills: the drawing, the shell and the finished room.

08:00 · Day one

Café

08:00 · Café01 / 07Skip the build ↓

  1. 01 The drawing

    Week 1 · Measured survey

    Counter on the brick wall, so the queue forms along it and not across the door. The stair stays where it is.

  2. 02 The sketch

    Week 2 · Concept

    Drawn from the door: the trusses, the steel stair, a ceiling of plants to walk in under.

  3. 03 The shell

    Week 4 · Strip-out and making good

    Brick cleaned back, trusses painted, the mezzanine made safe. Everything stays white until it’s decided.

  4. 04 Joinery & fit-out

    Weeks 6–9 · Joinery and FF&E

    The steel stair goes in first, then the counter and the bench. Planters next, and the tables work round them.

  5. 05 Finishes

    Weeks 10–11 · Floor, brick, paint

    Screed polished, brick sealed, walls in a warm white that holds the morning light. Beech tops, a pine counter.

  6. 06 Lights on

    Week 12 · Lighting and commissioning

    Bare lamps on long flex at 2,700 K. 300 lux on the counter, softer everywhere else.

  7. 07 Open

    Day one · 08:00

    Doors at eight. The queue moves.

In numbers

7 in 10 clients come back to us for a second site.

Planned for the rush

We plan the counter before the room — order, make, pick-up — so two baristas do the work of three.

Approvals

Fire, exit and extraction drawings done to the conditions from day one. Nothing gets ripped out later.

Made in our workshop

The counter and the bench are made off-site, so time on site is days, not weeks.

Book a free site walk →

One contract

Every finish on a sample board first. Then one fixed price for the design and the build.
